metadata.title: Premium Body Care and Home Fragrance Data Assets
metadata.description: Starter catalog of customer, commerce, product, store, and compliance data assets for the Premium Body Care and Home Fragrance domain.

rootGroups.name: People, Accounts, and Access Data
rootGroups.description: Profiles, accounts, credentials, consent, entitlements, and access records used to identify people and govern their access.

subGroups.name: Core Records
subGroups.description: Durable domain entities and business objects.

assets.name: Customer Profile
assets.description: Customer account, routine preferences, membership state, contact details, and saved gift-recipient signals.
assets.accessScope: customer journeys, loyalty operations, and approved service workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Shared customer memory for discovery, replenishment, gifting, service, and retention.

interfaces.name: Customer Profile API
interfaces.description: Read and update approved customer profile attributes.

governance.retention: active account plus regulated retention window
governance.sharingPolicy: approved product, service, and privacy workflows only

assets.name: Scent Profile
assets.description: Customer scent families, routine needs, ingredient sensitivities, room moments, and gift-recipient preferences.
assets.accessScope: recommendations, advisor consultations, replenishment, and gifting
assets.businessMeaning: Translates sensory and routine intent into recommendations and service context.

interfaces.name: Scent Profile API
interfaces.description: Preference interface for recommendations and advisor flows.

governance.retention: preference retention aligned with active customer relationship

assets.name: Loyalty Account
assets.description: Membership tier, points, rewards, benefits, birthday state, refill benefits, and offer eligibility.
assets.accessScope: member journeys, checkout, service, and marketing
assets.businessMeaning: Member value and retention state for routine continuity and benefits.

interfaces.name: Loyalty API
interfaces.description: Membership and benefit state for channels.

governance.retention: active membership plus financial retention window
governance.sharingPolicy: member value and approved marketing usage

assets.name: Gift Configuration
assets.description: Occasion, budget, recipient profile, gift wrap, card, message, and delivery promise choices.
assets.accessScope: gift builder, checkout, fulfillment, and care workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Controls how a gift is configured, presented, and fulfilled.

interfaces.name: Gift Configuration API
interfaces.description: Gift choices and eligibility for checkout and fulfillment.

governance.retention: order lifecycle plus customer preference window

assets.name: Consent Record
assets.description: Marketing, tracking, privacy, and clienteling consent decisions with audit history.
assets.accessScope: privacy enforcement, marketing eligibility, and assisted service
assets.businessMeaning: Determines which personalization, messaging, and advisor workflows are legally usable.

interfaces.name: Consent API
interfaces.description: Decisioning interface for customer consent and preference use.

assets.name: Personalization Decision
assets.description: Recommendation, offer, content, sample, and next-best-action decisions with context and outcome telemetry.
assets.accessScope: recommendations, member journeys, advisor support, and measurement
assets.businessMeaning: Explains what the product personalized, why, and whether it helped.

interfaces.name: Personalization Decision Event
interfaces.description: Decision and outcome stream for personalization.

subGroups.name: Reference and Policy Data
subGroups.description: Reference lists, policies, rules, configuration, and taxonomies.

assets.name: Refill Compatibility
assets.description: Refillable container, cartridge, bottle, pouch, dispenser, and packaging compatibility rules.
assets.accessScope: product pages, recommendations, checkout, store advice, and support
assets.businessMeaning: Prevents wrong refill purchases and supports circular packaging adoption.

interfaces.name: Refill Compatibility API
interfaces.description: Compatibility checks for refill and packaging choices.

subGroups.name: Analytics and Derived Data
subGroups.description: Aggregated, calculated, scored, predicted, or insight-oriented datasets.

assets.name: Replenishment Signal
assets.description: Predicted depletion, reorder timing, routine cadence, and reminder-state signals.
assets.accessScope: member replenishment, reminders, and offer orchestration
assets.businessMeaning: Predicts when a customer is likely ready to reorder or refill.

interfaces.name: Replenishment Signal Event
interfaces.description: Published reminder and reorder readiness signals.

rootGroups.name: Commercial and Financial Data
rootGroups.description: Pricing, payment, billing, subscription, revenue, settlement, ledger, and other commercial records.

subGroups.name: Financial Records
subGroups.description: Commercial, payment, billing, ledger, and settlement records.

assets.name: Checkout Session
assets.description: Cart, address, gift, shipping, promotion, tax, payment-intent, and consent state during checkout.
assets.accessScope: checkout and order creation only
assets.businessMeaning: Active purchase state that must be correct and recoverable.

assets.name: Order History
assets.description: Order line, status, return, channel, delivery, pickup, gift, and customer service history.
assets.accessScope: customer service, replenishment, returns, analytics, and financial reporting
assets.businessMeaning: Trusted purchase memory for service, retention, reporting, and replenishment.

governance.sharingPolicy: approved service, fulfillment, financial, and analytics use

assets.name: POS Transaction
assets.description: Store sale, return, exchange, tender, employee, location, and assisted checkout event state.
assets.accessScope: point of sale, finance, loyalty, returns, and store operations
assets.businessMeaning: Store transaction truth for revenue, inventory, loyalty, and service recovery.

interfaces.name: POS Transaction Event
interfaces.description: Store transaction and return event stream.

governance.retention: financial and store operations retention window
governance.sharingPolicy: approved finance, loyalty, and operations use

assets.name: Payment Transaction
assets.description: Payment authorization, capture, refund, fraud, wallet, tender, and chargeback records.
assets.accessScope: payment, refund, finance, and fraud workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Financial truth for order payment state and recovery.

interfaces.name: Payment Transaction API
interfaces.description: Payment state interface without raw card data exposure.

assets.name: Sample Redemption
assets.description: Sample eligibility, redemption, shipment, in-store handout, and conversion tracking.
assets.accessScope: sampling, checkout, store service, and campaign measurement
assets.businessMeaning: Connects trial programs to full-size purchase conversion.

assets.name: Tax Record
assets.description: Tax calculation, fiscal receipt, jurisdiction, exemption, invoice, and audit state.
assets.accessScope: checkout, order, POS, finance, and statutory reporting workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Financial and statutory truth for tax and fiscal receipts.

interfaces.name: Tax Record API
interfaces.description: Tax calculation and fiscal receipt interface.

assets.name: Price Book
assets.description: Market, channel, currency, SKU, margin, markdown, tax-inclusive, and effective-date pricing rules.
assets.accessScope: commerce, POS, marketplace, and finance workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Controls commercial price truth and margin guardrails.

subGroups.name: Reference and Policy Data
subGroups.description: Reference lists, policies, rules, configuration, and taxonomies.

assets.name: Promotion Rule
assets.description: Offer eligibility, loyalty benefits, gift thresholds, exclusions, regions, and margin guardrails.
assets.accessScope: commerce, loyalty, marketing, and point-of-sale workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Controls offer trust, margin protection, and benefit eligibility.

rootGroups.name: Product, Catalog, and Content Data
rootGroups.description: Catalogs, listings, inventory, content, media, products, and merchandising data exposed through customer or operator experiences.

subGroups.name: Core Records
subGroups.description: Durable domain entities and business objects.

assets.name: Store Inventory
assets.description: Store-level shelf, back-room, tester, reservation, pickup, and endless-aisle stock state.
assets.accessScope: store operations, customer availability, advisor service, and replenishment
assets.businessMeaning: Operational truth for boutique service, pickup, and stock recovery.

interfaces.name: Store Inventory API
interfaces.description: Store stock and reservation state for channels.

governance.sharingPolicy: approved store and customer availability usage

assets.name: Inventory Position
assets.description: Warehouse and store on-hand, available-to-promise, reservations, backorder state, and allocation rules.
assets.accessScope: commerce, store, fulfillment, planning, and service workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Determines whether a product can be sold, reserved, picked up, or recovered.

assets.name: Product Catalog
assets.description: Published products, SKUs, collections, prices, claims, scent notes, sizes, bundles, refills, and market availability.
assets.accessScope: commerce, store, content, recommendation, and partner channels
assets.businessMeaning: Single commercial view of sellable products and product experience attributes.

interfaces.name: Product Catalog API
interfaces.description: Published product data for channels and product bricks.

assets.name: Launch Plan
assets.description: Collection launch calendar, market scope, assortment, channel readiness, campaign assets, and launch risks.
assets.accessScope: product, channel, marketing, operations, and store readiness workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Coordinates seasonal and collection launches across the operating model.

assets.name: Product Master Data
assets.description: Pre-publication product setup, SKU structures, market readiness, taxonomy, translations, and lifecycle state.
assets.accessScope: assortment, PIM, launch, compliance, and catalog publication
assets.businessMeaning: Controls whether products can be safely launched and sold across markets.

interfaces.name: Product Master API
interfaces.description: Product setup and readiness state for launch workflows.

assets.name: Campaign Calendar
assets.description: Seasonal campaign, collection, gift, promotion, launch, and content placement calendar.
assets.accessScope: brand home, promotions, content, stores, and launch coordination
assets.businessMeaning: Coordinates campaign timing and channel entry points.

assets.name: Formula Record
assets.description: Formula, fragrance, raw material, stability, compatibility, and packaging development records.
assets.accessScope: product development, quality, and compliance workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Protects proprietary product development knowledge and supports claim substantiation.

interfaces.name: Formula Governance API
interfaces.description: Controlled access to formula and compatibility evidence.

subGroups.name: Reference and Policy Data
subGroups.description: Reference lists, policies, rules, configuration, and taxonomies.

assets.name: Ingredient and Claim Record
assets.description: Approved ingredient, fragrance, usage, refill, cruelty-free, safety, and sustainability claim metadata.
assets.accessScope: product pages, packaging, advisor content, regulatory review, and customer support
assets.businessMeaning: Keeps product claims accurate, localizable, and defensible.

interfaces.name: Claims API
interfaces.description: Approved claim interface for customer and compliance surfaces.

governance.retention: regulated product and claim audit window
governance.sharingPolicy: approved product, legal, and customer-facing usage

subGroups.name: Documents and Evidence
subGroups.description: Documents, media, knowledge, files, and evidence packages.

assets.name: Product Review
assets.description: Ratings, reviews, review moderation, helpfulness votes, and scent or texture feedback.
assets.accessScope: product pages, moderation, care, and analytics
assets.businessMeaning: Customer trust signal for sensory and gifting decisions.

assets.name: Education Content
assets.description: Scent, routine, usage, refill, ingredient, advisor, and brand education content.
assets.accessScope: product pages, advisor tooling, customer education, and launch support
assets.businessMeaning: Explains how products, rituals, ingredients, and refills should be understood and used.

interfaces.name: Education Content API
interfaces.description: Published education content for channels and advisor surfaces.

rootGroups.name: Operational Workflow and Event Data
rootGroups.description: Orders, bookings, trips, tasks, incidents, service requests, workflow states, and operational events used to run the domain.

subGroups.name: Core Records
subGroups.description: Durable domain entities and business objects.

assets.name: Support Case
assets.description: Customer issue, return, refund, exchange, delivery, packaging, product quality, and recovery history.
assets.accessScope: care, store service, quality, fulfillment, and product improvement
assets.businessMeaning: Customer recovery truth and source of defect signals.

governance.sharingPolicy: approved care, quality, and operations use

assets.name: Return Case
assets.description: Return, exchange, refund, product issue, reason, eligibility, inspection, and recovery state.
assets.accessScope: customer care, POS, warehouse, finance, and quality workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Controls customer recovery and return economics.

governance.sharingPolicy: approved care, finance, and quality use

assets.name: Experiment Assignment
assets.description: Experiment, feature flag, cohort, treatment, exposure, and guardrail measurement assignments.
assets.accessScope: experimentation, feature rollout, and KPI measurement
assets.businessMeaning: Controls test exposure and enables trustworthy product decisions.

assets.name: Fulfillment Promise
assets.description: Delivery, pickup, carrier, cut-off, packaging, and promise-kept state.
assets.accessScope: checkout, order tracking, store pickup, and care workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Sets and measures the promise customers experience for delivery and pickup.

governance.retention: order lifecycle plus service retention window

assets.name: Store Task
assets.description: Campaign, replenishment, merchandising, training, launch, pickup, and audit tasks assigned to stores.
assets.accessScope: store execution, launch readiness, and retail operations
assets.businessMeaning: Controls execution quality across boutiques and counters.

assets.name: Appointment
assets.description: Booking, service type, advisor assignment, store, attendance, outcome, and post-session survey state.
assets.accessScope: store booking, advisor workflow, and service analytics
assets.businessMeaning: Coordinates assisted service capacity and conversion measurement.

subGroups.name: Events and Logs
subGroups.description: Append-only events, logs, state changes, and operational traces.

assets.name: Recommendation Event
assets.description: Recommendation impression, selection, suppression, model context, and downstream purchase outcome events.
assets.accessScope: recommendation quality, personalization, experimentation, and measurement
assets.businessMeaning: Measures whether scent, routine, gift, and refill recommendations help customers.

assets.name: Behavior Event
assets.description: Anonymous and consented customer behavior events for discovery, search, product detail, cart, replenishment, and service journeys.
assets.accessScope: analytics, personalization, experimentation, and product measurement
assets.businessMeaning: Measurement spine for product improvement and KPI reporting.

interfaces.name: Behavior Event Stream
interfaces.description: Instrumented product events for analytics and personalization.

assets.name: Search Query Log
assets.description: Search query, browse filter, zero-result, sort, click, and add-to-basket events.
assets.accessScope: search quality, merchandising, personalization, and analytics
assets.businessMeaning: Shows what shoppers seek and where discovery fails.

rootGroups.name: Risk, Governance, Security, and Compliance Data
rootGroups.description: Risk signals, safety records, audit trails, policies, controls, approvals, and compliance evidence.

subGroups.name: Core Records
subGroups.description: Durable domain entities and business objects.

assets.name: Session Token
assets.description: Short-lived authenticated session, refresh, revocation, and risk metadata.
assets.accessScope: runtime authentication and authorization only
assets.businessMeaning: Keeps customer, advisor, and operations sessions secure.

assets.name: Identity Credential
assets.description: Credential metadata, authentication factors, password hash references, and account recovery state.
assets.accessScope: identity platform and account security workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Protects access to customer accounts, member benefits, advisor tools, and operations consoles.

assets.name: Risk Decision
assets.description: Fraud, abuse, return-risk, payment-risk, promotion-abuse, and account-risk decisions.
assets.accessScope: checkout, payment, promotion, return, and account protection workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Protects customers, margin, and payment operations from abuse.

assets.name: Compliance Decision
assets.description: Product claim approvals, launch gates, market restrictions, safety outcomes, and audit decisions.
assets.accessScope: launch, legal, quality, catalog, and market operations
assets.businessMeaning: Determines whether a product or claim can be sold or shown in a market.

interfaces.name: Compliance Decision API
interfaces.description: Launch and claim decision state for product workflows.

subGroups.name: Events and Logs
subGroups.description: Append-only events, logs, state changes, and operational traces.

assets.name: Audit Log
assets.description: Immutable audit events for claim approval, consent decisions, product publication, payment changes, and administrative access.
assets.accessScope: security, compliance, privacy, and regulated audit workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Provides traceability for sensitive decisions and regulated workflows.

subGroups.name: Documents and Evidence
subGroups.description: Documents, media, knowledge, files, and evidence packages.

assets.name: Supplier Evidence
assets.description: Supplier contracts, sourcing attestations, audit evidence, raw material certifications, and corrective actions.
assets.accessScope: sourcing, compliance, sustainability, and risk workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Supports ethical sourcing claims and supplier risk control.

interfaces.name: Supplier Evidence API
interfaces.description: Evidence interface for sourcing and compliance processes.

governance.retention: supplier contract and audit retention window

rootGroups.name: Core Domain Records
rootGroups.description: Primary domain records that do not fit a more specialized data group.

subGroups.name: Core Records
subGroups.description: Durable domain entities and business objects.

assets.name: Consultation Note
assets.description: Advisor-created notes, recommended products, scent preferences, skin needs, and follow-up context.
assets.accessScope: advisor service, customer recovery, recommendations, and consent-governed follow-up
assets.businessMeaning: Connects boutique advice to digital continuity and future purchases.

governance.sharingPolicy: consent-governed advisor and customer service use

assets.name: Bundle Definition
assets.description: Gift set, routine bundle, component, substitution, margin, and channel eligibility rules.
assets.accessScope: gift builder, catalog, checkout, and merchandising workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Determines which premium sets and routine bundles are sellable.
